title: Find the ARM template selection at a glance.
description: Import ARM highlights file selection with a larger blue Choose template.json button, folder icon, clear guidance and filename status.

before.caption: Template selection used a small outline button

after.caption: A highlighted panel makes template selection clear

note: The Steps and demo panels start at the same height on desktop. The selection panel supports all eight languages, both themes and narrow screens. Only Choose template.json opens the file picker; the silent demo and local import workflow are unchanged.

title: Keep group properties to the right of the resource name.
description: Group headers show the full wrapped name on the left, with IP addresses and custom property chips together on the right.

before.caption: Property chips appeared below long names

after.caption: Names stay on the left and properties stay on the right

note: In narrow boxes, property chips wrap within the right-hand area. Notes remain underneath. Existing diagram sizes, names, field values and double-click editing are preserved.

title: Read long resource names without an ellipsis.
description: Resource names wrap onto additional lines, including VNets and other groups. Long identifiers without spaces wrap too.

before.caption: Long group names ended with an ellipsis

after.caption: The full resource name wraps onto additional lines

note: Group property chips move to another row when needed, and notes stay below the header. Names remain editable by double-clicking; the stored name is unchanged by wrapping.

title: See new product updates when you open the studio.
description: What's new now opens once for each unread product update, using the same release history and before/after images.

before.caption: Updates were available only through the What's new link

after.caption: The existing What's new dialog appears automatically

note: The preview closes after five seconds in a visible tab. Click, scroll or use the keyboard to keep reading. Open What's new manually whenever you like; manual viewing has no timer. Bug-fix-only builds do not trigger announcements.

title: Shape text sizes now go up to 128px.
description: Choose 48, 56, 64, 72, 96 or 128px while editing Text boxes, arrows, callouts and other text-capable shapes.

after.caption: Choose larger text sizes up to 128px

note: Dense text may still shrink to fit. Enlarge the shape to give it more room. Existing diagrams and default text sizes are unchanged.

title: Add a Database shape to your diagram.
description: Database is now the last tile in Shapes, immediately after the brick wall. Click or drag it onto the canvas.

before.caption: Empty slot after the brick wall

after.caption: Database fills the last Shapes slot

note: Resize, rotate and double-click to edit text. Save JSON keeps it editable; PNG, SVG and screenshots include the shape.

title: Align and space text in every shape.
description: Double-click a text-capable shape to use left, center or right alignment, indent controls, and paragraph and line spacing. Works with Text boxes, arrows, callouts and other shapes.

before.caption: Only text size, bold and color were available

after.caption: Alignment, indentation and spacing for all text in a shape

note: Formatting applies to the whole shape, not just selected text. Open the alignment menu for Paragraph spacing. Save JSON and image exports keep the formatting.

title: Your update history, in one place.
description: Open What's new from the version link or Settings. Browse dated releases, compare before/after images and reopen the history whenever you need it.

before.caption: Only the version number was available

after.caption: A centered, scrollable history with visual comparisons

note: History is included offline in both editions. A New badge appears for a version you have not viewed.

title: See-through controls. Clear text and icons.
description: Fullscreen, the drawing toolbar, tabs and Notes have 55% transparent backgrounds. Text, icons and selected tools stay solid. Light and dark themes, hover and keyboard focus are preserved.

before.caption: Solid surfaces hide the diagram underneath

after.caption: The diagram shows through; controls stay readable

note: Actual controls over matching sample diagram lines. Open menus and the Notes editor remain opaque.

title: Arrange your diagram tabs your way.
description: Drag any tab, including Overview, to reorder it. Or focus a tab and press Alt+Left/Right. The active workspace stays open, and browser auto-save remembers the order.

before.caption: Tabs stay in their original order

after.caption: Reorder tabs without switching your diagram

note: Browser auto-save remembers tab order. Save JSON still saves only the current diagram.

title: Smoother panning and resource dragging.
description: Hand panning and object dragging do less redraw work. Resources, connectors, shapes and pencil strokes stay editable. Undo, saved positions and tab views retain their existing behavior.

before.caption: Longer drag frame gaps in the measured workload

after.caption: Shorter frame gaps in the same workload

note: 54 nodes, 62 connectors, 48 shapes and 12 pencil strokes. Median of three controlled runs; results vary.
